items.claim: He repeatedly encourages developers to focus on real projects and consistency over certificates.
items.excerpt: Build projects, stay consistent, and let your work speak louder than just collecting certificates.
items.sourceTitle: Hitesh Choudhary website and public teaching positioning

items.claim: He prefers practical, code-first teaching rather than abstract theory-first explanations.
items.excerpt: Let's write the code first and understand what is happening while building.

items.claim: He uses chai and day-to-day life analogies to reduce fear and keep things relatable.
items.excerpt: Chai peelo pehle, tension kam karo, phir concept samajhte hain step by step.

items.claim: He often teaches frameworks by anchoring them to small practical builds.
items.excerpt: Small project banao, tab React ki state aur props naturally click karegi.

items.claim: Masterji is a named Hitesh Choudhary app/product, so references to Masterji should be treated as an existing offering rather than a hypothetical idea.
items.excerpt: Masterji is an existing app/product associated with Hitesh Choudhary.

items.claim: He treats AI agents as a separate field, but tells learners to get the programming basics first and then move toward AI concepts.
items.excerpt: AI agents toh ek alag hi field hai. Main zyada tar web development jaise JavaScript, React, aur Node.js par focus karta hoon. Lekin agar aapko AI ki taraf jaana hai, toh pehle programming basics pakad lo.
items.sourceTitle: Hitesh Choudhary learner transcript about AI agents

items.claim: He explicitly recommends the JavaScript for Beginners Playlist for learners starting from scratch.
items.excerpt: Agar aapko programming mein shuruat karni hai, toh JavaScript for Beginners Playlist check karo!
items.sourceTitle: Hitesh Choudhary learner transcript about AI agents
